invariants.rationale: Method expects a valid rollback instant time string; null likely not acceptable.
Method likely expects a non-null HoodieInstant marking the commit to be rolled back.
A non-null execution context is generally required for distributed Hoodie actions.
The rollback instant time is expected to be a non-empty string representing an instant.
It may be invalid or unsafe to request both deleteInstants and skipLocking at the same time.
